lines.text: They led Jesus to the high priest, and Peter followed at a distance and warmed himself by the fire.
The council sought testimony against Jesus, but false witnesses said He would destroy the temple and rebuild in three days.
Jesus stayed silent, then told the high priest He was the Christ and would come with the clouds.
The high priest tore his clothes and called it treason, and they condemned Jesus to death and spat on Him.
Bystanders said Peter was a Judean who followed Jesus; he denied it, cursed and swore, and the rooster crowed twice.
